title: Lovely Pop 2 in 1: Jan Jan Koi Shimasho
native_title: ラブリー・ポップ２ｉｎ１ ～雀じゃん恋しましょ～
overview:
Lovely Pop 2 in 1: Jang Jang Koi Shimasho is a compilation of two arcade table games by Visco:

• Super Real Hanafuda: Koi Koi Shimasho
• Lovely Pop Mahjong: Jang Jang Shimasho

Both games are modified from the original arcade releases: all nudity has been censored, there are now higher-quality animated cutscenes, and free battle modes have been added in addition to the main story modes. This is the only release of either game on the Saturn.
